dataset: S-BIAD2196 CellTrack, all movies the deposit contains

leakage.policy: TiJepa-0's corpus contained R08:H4, the twin of 08_H4, so E0 comparisons are given with and without 08_H4; an evaluation movie with a twin in the frozen v1 corpus is excluded for every model trained on it

track_selection.rule: tracks of >= 33 frames over the whole movie; up to 50 per movie drawn without replacement with numpy default_rng((20261016, movie-name bytes)); all if fewer

survival_definition: number of frames tracked before the first frame whose position error exceeds 8 um (the whole track if never)
ltdb: not provided by the author; see results/v2/manual_intake.json
cotracker: not run: dl.fbaipublicfiles.com was unreachable in v1 preflight; the Hugging Face route was not attempted

E4s_tijepa1_spatial.note: matched-step spatial-only ablation; queried with a future mask it never saw in training, so its forecasting ratio is out of distribution

E0_tijepa0.note: historical reference: different corpus, not a valid ablation

statistics: 6 movies is below the 10-group minimum, so no bootstrap CI is reported (rule 3); per-movie values and an exact sign-flip permutation are given instead.
